title: Persona Dream typed edit intent (planning-only boundary)
description: A typed edit intent names exactly one storyboard panel frame target in one frozen revision, the requested change, preservation constraints, and a planning-only execution boundary. Compiling it produces a dependency-aware revision plan; it never activates a successor, calls a provider, or writes persona memory.

intent_id.description: Caller-chosen stable intent identifier; echoed into the plan.

kind.description: identity_source_change is recognized but always refused as out of scope for a panel edit intent; identity truth changes flow through create_successor_revision.py, not through edit planning.

execution_boundary.description: The only accepted boundary. Planning writes a plan artifact plus receipt; it never activates a successor revision, never calls a provider, and never writes persona memory.
